purpose: Append-only evidence schema for reconstructing Second Shift lane state and useful execution without treating architectural peer admission as execution authority.
storage_rule: Use one lane-owned ledger per execution-ready shift lane per date under governance/second-shift/execution-events/YYYY-MM-DD/. The active permitted lane set must remain synchronized with the authority-selected Second Shift registry owner_files and Topology 006 execution readiness. Historical SYSTEM_MASTER and PROSE ledgers remain immutable evidence but are not current lanes.
claim_lifecycle_rules: CLAIMED opens exactly one mutation-capable lease for an execution-ready active lane; a second live claim is invalid.
RUNNING and PROGRESS require a live preceding CLAIMED lease for the same delegation, control head and idempotency key.
HEARTBEAT must refer to the live lease and preserve the same idempotency key while advancing a durable checkpoint pointer.
COMPLETED, BLOCKED or STALE releases the live lease for that delegation; successor work requires a new claim after current-owner revalidation.
SHIFT_CLOSE is invalid while a mutation-capable lease remains unresolved.
event_order_rules: event_id values are unique within a lane ledger.
occurred_at values are monotonic nondecreasing within the append-only ledger.
Every current-state event uses the exact current owner control_ref and control_head observed for that event.
IDLE_VALID requires a preceding same-head ALL_RUNGS_EXHAUSTED event containing exactly eight rung dispositions and independent_work_remaining=false.
retry_rules: retry_budget must be an integer from 1 through max_retry_budget.
After retry budget exhaustion the dependency becomes CIRCUIT_OPEN for that invocation and the lane switches to a dependency-valid fallback rung when one exists.
Repeated transient failure never proves whole-lane exhaustion.
utilization_rules: Telemetry is factual and missing telemetry remains UNKNOWN rather than inferred.
Current Second Shift telemetry is permitted only for execution-ready peer lanes CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS.
SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE are architectural peers but emit no Second Shift telemetry until canonical control records and execution readiness are established.
PROSE is complete and terminally retired and never generates new telemetry.
Any genuinely open preserved-Prose integration is BOOK telemetry only.
PROGRAMMING product work has no peer utilization ledger before explicit topology admission; Knowledge Recovery support is recorded under CORE.
retired_system_rule: A historical PROSE ledger may be read only as immutable evidence. No controller, auto-provisioner, repair broker, qualifier or successor binder may create a new PROSE ledger.
authority_boundary: This ledger records execution state only. Architectural admission does not grant dispatch authority. It never grants PASS, promotion, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, native, publication or production authority.
